recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Procedure.notDone or Procedure.reasonNotDone; future changes to negated Procedure semantics should be handled as new Patient Care/workflow decisions.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care ballot comment asking how FHIR can specify that a Procedure did not occur; the resolution directed adding a Procedure not-done indicator and not-done reason with invariants, with ProcedureRequest listed as a related artifact.
initial_application: Commit 41dd59e1c0031104575f31ec53d420561bd65f40 applied #5180 by adding Procedure.notDone, Procedure.reasonNotDone, a reasonNotDone invariant, and a procedure negation reason value set to the then-authoritative Procedure spreadsheet source.
additional_context: FHIR-5707 supplied the related Procedure status lifecycle context. FHIR-11027 later clarified negation scope and that guidance is preserved in current Procedure.status comments. FHIR-14063 intentionally superseded the original boolean representation with event-pattern status not-done plus statusReason. ProcedureRequest is retired and fhir.ini records it as merged into active ServiceRequest.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current active Procedure source includes status not-done, Procedure.statusReason bound to procedure-not-performed-reason, and scope guidance for non-occurrence; active ServiceRequest includes statusReason and doNotPerform for the successor request-pattern side.

related_jiras.note: Procedure status lifecycle work was explicitly referenced from FHIR-5180 and explains the status-based context now used for non-occurrence.
